description: Search Library of Congress Subject Headings (LCSH) by keyword. Returns controlled-vocabulary subject labels and their URIs. Use the returned label as the subject filter in libofcongress_search — LCSH uses precise, standardized terms that differ from natural language (e.g., "World War, 1939-1945" not "World War II"; "Photography, Aerial" not "Aerial photography"). Running this tool before a subject-filtered libofcongress_search dramatically improves result quality.

limit.description: Maximum number of subject headings to return. Default 10, max 50.

query.description: Keyword or partial subject heading to search for (e.g., "civil war", "immigration", "jazz").

name: libofcongress_search_subjects

cap.description: The limit applied to this response — maximum headings the API will return.

effectiveQuery.description: The keyword query as submitted to the id.loc.gov suggest endpoint, after trimming.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Recovery hint when results are empty, or when the upstream candidate cap under-filled the request. Distinguishes "exhausted by ranking" (retry with a more specific query) from "no LCSH coverage", and suggests inverted-form strategies. Absent when the full requested set was returned.

shown.description: Number of subject headings returned in this response.

subjects.description: LCSH subject headings matching the query, ordered by relevance. To see how many LOC items carry a heading, pass its label as the libofcongress_search subject filter and read total.

items.description: A single LCSH subject heading record.

label.description: Standardized LCSH heading — use this exact string in the libofcongress_search subject filter.

uri.description: Stable LOC URI identifying this subject heading in the authority file.

truncated.description: True when results were capped at the requested limit. Increase limit or refine the query to surface additional headings.

title: Search LC Subject Headings
